name: ShopWriter Lite
author: Manolito van de Wouw

sections.description:
ShopWriter Lite is a powerful AI content generator specifically designed for WooCommerce stores. Save hours of manual work by automatically generating high-quality, SEO-optimized product content.

Features

  • Short Description Generation – Create compelling short descriptions that capture your product’s essence
  • Product Description Generation – Generate detailed, engaging product descriptions
  • Meta Title Generation – SEO-optimized meta titles for better search rankings
  • Meta Description Generation – Compelling meta descriptions to improve click-through rates
  • Featured Image Alt Text – Accessible and SEO-friendly alt text for product images
  • Bulk Generator – Process multiple products at once to save time
  • Content History – Track all generated content with revert capability
  • Multiple Operations – Generate new content or rewrite existing content
  • SEO Plugin Integration – Works with Yoast SEO and Rank Math

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Enter your API key in the settings
  3. Navigate to any WooCommerce product or use the Bulk Generator
  4. Select the fields you want to generate
  5. Click Generate and review the AI-powered content
  6. Apply the content to your product

Why Choose ShopWriter Lite?

  • Save Time – Generate content for hundreds of products in minutes
  • Improve SEO – AI-optimized content helps your products rank higher
  • Increase Sales – Better descriptions lead to higher conversion rates
  • Easy to Use – Simple interface that works right in your WordPress admin
  • WooCommerce Native – Built specifically for WooCommerce stores

With ShopWriter Lite, you can optimize a limited number of products each month. Need more? Upgrade to ShopWriter Pro!

Pro Version

Upgrade to ShopWriter Pro for additional features:

  • Product Title Generation
  • FAQ Section Generation
  • Category Description Generator
  • All Gallery Images Alt Text
  • Custom AI Instructions
  • Content Length Settings
  • 301 Redirects Management
  • Background Queue Processing
  • Open Graph Meta Tags
  • Priority Support

Upgrade to Pro

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • ShopWriter API key (get one at shop-writer.com)

Privacy Policy

ShopWriter Lite connects to the ShopWriter API service to generate content. When you use the content generation feature, the following data is sent to our servers:

  • Product name and attributes
  • Current product description (for rewrite operations)
  • Category names
  • Selected language preferences

This data is processed solely for the purpose of generating content and is not stored permanently on our servers. For more information, please visit our Privacy Policy.

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please:

  • Visit our Support Center
  • Email us at support@shop-writer.com

Credits

ShopWriter Lite is developed and maintained by the ShopWriter team. We’re dedicated to helping WooCommerce store owners save time and improve their product content through the power of AI.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/shopwriter-lite directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to ShopWriter Lite > Settings to configure the plugin.
  4. Enter your API key and customize your preferences.
  5. Start generating content!

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  4. Click “Upload Plugin” at the top
  5. Select the zip file and click “Install Now”
  6. Activate the plugin after installation
sections.faq:
Where do I get an API key?

You can get an API key by signing up at shop-writer.com. Free credits are available to get you started.

What AI model does this plugin use?

ShopWriter uses advanced AI language models to generate high-quality, natural-sounding content. The specific model can be selected in the plugin settings.

Will this work with my WooCommerce theme?

Yes! ShopWriter Lite is designed to work with any WooCommerce-compatible theme. It generates content that is stored in standard WooCommerce product fields.

Can I edit the generated content?

Absolutely! All generated content is shown in a preview before being applied. You can review, edit, or regenerate content before saving it to your products.

Does this work with product variations?

Currently, ShopWriter Lite works with simple products, variable products (parent level), and other standard WooCommerce product types. Individual variation descriptions are available in the Pro version.

Is the generated content unique?

Yes, the AI generates unique content based on your product data, attributes, and categories. Each product gets its own customized content.

What languages are supported?

ShopWriter supports multiple languages. You can set your source language and target language in the settings. The AI will generate content in your specified target language.

Does this plugin slow down my site?

No, ShopWriter Lite only runs in the WordPress admin area. It does not affect your store’s frontend performance.

Can I revert to the original content?

Yes! ShopWriter Lite keeps a history of all content changes. You can view the history and revert to previous versions if needed.

How does the Bulk Generator work?

The Bulk Generator allows you to select multiple products by category or attribute filters. You can then generate content for all selected products at once, saving significant time.
